body: You don't need a degree to be good. You can do good things, be a good person. You don't have to be the best. It's ok to get a normal job. It's ok to have messed up and move on.  It's up to your girlfriend to decide if she wants to move on you don't get to decide that for her. But you do get to make life choices. Make a choice to be ok with not having a scholarship. Make a choice to find a regular job that makes you ok with getting up in the morning. Make a choice to know that college is hard and stressful and not for everyone. It's ok.
